issues.title: Progress bar not mirrored for RTL
issues.description: The progress indicator fills from left to right instead of right to left in RTL mode.
issues.evidence: The 33% fill begins at the left boundary of the progress track.
issues.suggestion: Reverse progress track fill direction to originate from the right in RTL.
issues.triageNote: Real defect: default progress rendering delegates to ui/progress whose indicator uses a physical translateX, so the fill stays anchored to the left edge in RTL; fixed inside questionnaire.tsx by rendering a direction-aware track (logical start-0 + width) instead of delegating.

issues.title: Misaligned questionnaire actions
issues.description: Supplementary action button is awkwardly stacked beneath primary navigation controls.
issues.evidence: The 'Lock in pricing' button sits right-aligned directly underneath 'Next' rather than in a cohesive action group.
issues.suggestion: Restructure QuestionnaireActions into a balanced horizontal or full-width button group.
issues.triageNote: Real defect: QuestionnaireActions uses flex-wrap + justify-end, so on narrow phones the wrapped supplementary action lands alone on a right-aligned second row; fixed by stacking actions as a full-width group on mobile (<30rem) viewports.

issues.title: Untranslated step counter
issues.description: The step counter displays in English instead of Hebrew.
issues.evidence: Header displays 'Question 1 of 3' amidst Hebrew UI text.
issues.suggestion: Localize the step counter string into Hebrew.
issues.triageNote: Real localizability defect: the step counter was hardcoded English with no override prop (every other questionnaire string is consumer-supplied); fixed by adding an additive stepLabel prop (string or ({current,total}) => string). The pair-107 eval page itself is off-limits (src/app/eval/**) and keeps the English default, but the component is now localizable per the DS useTranslation RTL-demo convention.
